spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bound, tied.
E.
मू to bind, aff. क्त.

r. 10th cl. (मूत्रयति)
To urine, to make water.

n. (-त्रं)
Urine, piss.
E.
मूत्र to piss, घञ् aff., or मुच to loose, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्, and ऊ substituted for the vowel.

Unrinary affection in general, as gravel, &c.
E.
मूत्र urine, and कृच्छ्र pain.

m. (-षः)
Gonorrhoea, considered as an urinary complaint.
E.
मूत्र urine, and दोष fault.

n. (-टं)
The lower belly.
E.
मूत्र urine, and पुट to be shallow, aff. क.

m. (-न्थिः)
Obstruction at the neck of the bladder.
E.
मूत्र, and ग्रन्थि knot.

m. (-र्गः)
The urethra.
E.
मूत्र, and मार्ग passage.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Diuretic.
mf. (-लः-ला)
A cucumber.
E.
मूत्र urine, and लच् aff.

n. (-क्रं)
Milky urine, depositing a thick white sediment.
E.
मूत्र, and शक्र semen, which is supposed to give the colour.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Urinary obstruction.
E.
मूत्र, and सङ्ग being with.

m. (-तः)
Suppression of urine.
E.
मूत्र, and आधात impediment.

m. (-तः)
Difficult or slow passage of urine.
E.
मूत्र, and अतीत passed.

m. (-यः)
1 The bladder.
2 The lower belly, the pubic region.
E.
मूत्र urine, and आशय place.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pissed, voided as urine.
E.
मूत्र to urine aff. क्त.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Obstructed or tardy flow of urine, discharge of it mixed with blood, &c.
E.
मूत्र, and उत्सङ्ग adhesion.
